mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_chunk(doc_id, kb_id, parent_id, seq, content, page_no, token_count, embedding_id, chunk_level, token_count_estimated) VALUES(#{docId}, #{kbId}, #{parentId}, #{seq}, #{content}, #{pageNo}, #{tokenCount}, #{embeddingId}, 'CHILD', #{tokenCountEstimated})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_chunk SET metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{chunkId}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO kb_parent_chunk(doc_id, kb_id, seq, content, page_no, token_count, metadata, token_count_estimated, document_version) VALUES(#{docId}, #{kbId}, #{seq}, #{content}, #{pageNo}, #{tokenCount}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{tokenEstimated}, COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb)->>'document_version', '')::int, 1)) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO kb_base_chunk(doc_id, kb_id, seq, content, page_no, token_count, block_type, layout_metadata, token_count_estimated) VALUES(#{docId}, #{kbId}, #{seq}, #{content}, #{pageNo}, #{tokenCount}, #{blockType}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{tokenEstimated}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_parent_chunk SET embedding_id = #{embeddingId} WHERE id = #{parentId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id AS "docId", kb_id AS "kbId", seq, content, page_no AS "pageNo", token_count AS "tokenCount", metadata, document_version AS "documentVersion" FROM kb_parent_chunk WHERE id = #{id}
